responseText:
I can’t change drive permissions from here or run a background watcher — and I won’t make an externally visible, potentially destructive change without explicit confirmation and the connector/automation to do it. I can, however, get everything ready so it’s truly off your plate once legal clears. Quick questions and options so I do exactly what you want:

Questions (need answers)
- Which platform? (Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, SharePoint, etc.)
- Exact folder: path and/or folder ID, or the Shared Drive name.
- Exact permission you want: “anyone at [company domain] with link can view” vs “anyone at [company domain] can find and view (no link needed)”. Also, do you want commenters or viewers?
- Apply to subfolders/files? Preserve existing owners/roles?
- Who counts as legal clearance trigger? (an email from Legal, a specific person’s approval, or you telling me to proceed?)
- Do you want notifications/audit log sent to anyone after the change?

What I can prepare now (choose one or more)
1) Step‑by‑step UI instructions you (or an admin) can follow right now for your platform. (Fast, manual.)
2) A ready‑to‑run automation script (Apps Script/PowerShell/Power Automate) plus deployment instructions so an admin can deploy it; you (or they) can run it when legal clears. (Requires admin privileges to deploy/run.)
3) A draft email to Legal requesting final clearance and instructions for them to reply/confirm — I can include the exact folder link and the intended permission text so their reply is unambiguous.
4) If you have a connector enabled here that can change Drive settings, I can execute the change now — but I’ll need you to confirm the exact target and permission and explicitly authorize me to proceed.

Recommended default if you want me to handle prep now
- Tell me the platform and folder ID (or paste the link), confirm permission level (domain view), and whether you want the script or the email draft. I’ll produce the script + deployment steps and a one‑click legal email draft; you can choose to deploy/run or have an admin do it once legal clears.

Next step
Reply with the platform and folder link/ID and which of the preparation options you want (1–4). If you want me to draft the email or script right away, say which.
